点1.meaning: point; dot; drop (雨点 raindrops); measure word for items, reasons, suggestions: 三个问题 three points, 一点意见 a small suggestion

examples.hanzi: 黑板上有一个红点。
examples.pinyin: hēibǎn shang yǒu yī gè hóng diǎn.
examples.english: There's a red dot on the blackboard.

examples.hanzi: 这次会议解决了三个点。
examples.pinyin: zhè cì huìyì jiějué le sān gè diǎn.
examples.english: This meeting resolved three points.

点1.meaning: o'clock; point in time (三点 three o'clock); decimal point (三点五 3.5); the point of something (起点 starting point)

examples.hanzi: 现在三点一刻。
examples.pinyin: xiànzài sān diǎn yī kè.
examples.english: It's a quarter past three now.

examples.hanzi: 三点五就是三点加零点五。
examples.pinyin: sān diǎn wǔ jiùshì sān diǎn jiā líng diǎn wǔ.
examples.english: 3.5 means three plus zero point five.

点1.meaning: to order (food or goods): 点菜 order dishes

examples.hanzi: 服务员，我们要点菜。
examples.pinyin: fúwùyuán, wǒmen yào diǎn cài.
examples.english: Waiter, we'd like to order.

点1.meaning: to light; to ignite: 点蜡烛 light a candle

examples.hanzi: 过生日的时候，孩子点了蜡烛。
examples.pinyin: guò shēngri de shíhou, háizi diǎn le làzhú.
examples.english: On the birthday, the children lit the candles.

点1.meaning: to click; to tap (a screen or mouse): 点一下图标 tap the icon

examples.hanzi: 用鼠标点一下这个图标。
examples.pinyin: yòng shǔbiāo diǎn yīxià zhège túbiāo.
examples.english: Click this icon with the mouse.

点1.meaning: aspect; feature (bound form): 优点 strong point, 重点 focus, 特点 characteristic

examples.hanzi: 她的优点是做事认真。
examples.pinyin: tā de yōudiǎn shì zuòshì rènzhēn.
examples.english: Her strong point is working conscientiously.

分.meaning: to divide; to separate; to distribute; to distinguish: 分开 separate, 分作业 hand out homework, 分不清 can't tell apart

examples.hanzi: 老师把同学们分成了两个组。
examples.pinyin: lǎoshī bǎ tóngxuémen fēn chéng le liǎng gè zǔ.
examples.english: The teacher divided the students into two groups.

分.meaning: minute (time unit); point (exam, game); cent (money): 十点十分 ten past ten, 一百分 one hundred points

examples.hanzi: 现在差十分十一点。
examples.pinyin: xiànzài chà shí fēn shíyī diǎn.
examples.english: It's ten minutes to eleven now.

examples.hanzi: 他考试得了一百分。
examples.pinyin: tā kǎoshì dé le yī bǎi fēn.
examples.english: He got one hundred points on the exam.

分.meaning: branch (of an organization); fraction: 三分之一 one third

examples.hanzi: 我在这家公司的分部工作。
examples.pinyin: wǒ zài zhè jiā gōngsī de fēnbù gōngzuò.
examples.english: I work at this company's branch office.

回.meaning: measure word for occurrences of an action: 说过两回 said it twice (colloquial; same use as 次)

examples.hanzi: 这个问题我问过他两回。
examples.pinyin: zhège wèntí wǒ wèn guo tā liǎng huí.
examples.english: I've asked him this question twice.

回.meaning: to return; to go back: 回家 go home, 回国 return to one's country

examples.hanzi: 太晚了，我要回家了。
examples.pinyin: tài wǎn le, wǒ yào huí jiā le.
examples.english: It's too late; I'm going home.

examples.hanzi: 他明年回国。
examples.pinyin: tā míngnián huí guó.
examples.english: He's returning to his country next year.

回.meaning: to reply; to return (a message or call): 回电话 return a call, 回信 reply to a letter

examples.hanzi: 请尽快回我电话。
examples.pinyin: qǐng jǐnkuài huí wǒ diànhuà.
examples.english: Please call me back as soon as possible.

回.meaning: chapter (of classic novels) — 一回 one chapter; beyond HSK3

examples.hanzi: 爷爷在看一本小说的第五回。
examples.pinyin: yéye zài kàn yī běn xiǎoshuō de dì wǔ huí.
examples.english: Grandpa is reading chapter five of a novel.

家.meaning: home; house; family: 在家 at home, 一家人 the whole family

examples.hanzi: 下午我都在家。
examples.pinyin: xiàwǔ wǒ dōu zài jiā.
examples.english: I'm at home all afternoon.

examples.hanzi: 我们家人都喜欢运动。
examples.pinyin: wǒmen jiārén dōu xǐhuān yùndòng.
examples.english: Everyone in our family likes sports.

家.meaning: measure word for businesses and institutions: 一家饭店 a restaurant, 一家公司 a company

examples.hanzi: 学校旁边新开了一家饭店。
examples.pinyin: xuéxiào pángbiān xīn kāi le yī jiā fàndiàn.
examples.english: A new restaurant opened next to the school.

家.meaning: specialist in a field (bound form): 科学家 scientist, 作家 writer

examples.hanzi: 她是一位有名的画家。
examples.pinyin: tā shì yī wèi yǒumíng de huàjiā.
examples.english: She is a famous painter.

有些.meaning: some; certain (of people or things): 有些同学 some classmates, 有些地方 some places

examples.hanzi: 有些同学已经学过两年汉语了。
examples.pinyin: yǒuxiē tóngxué yǐjīng xué guo liǎng nián Hànyǔ le.
examples.english: Some classmates have already studied Chinese for two years.

有些.meaning: somewhat; rather (before an adjective): 有些累 somewhat tired, 有些贵 a bit expensive

examples.hanzi: 走了这么久，我有些饿了。
examples.pinyin: zǒu le zhème jiǔ, wǒ yǒuxiē è le.
examples.english: After walking so long, I'm somewhat hungry.

头.meaning: head: 头疼 headache, 洗头 wash one's hair, 梳头 comb one's hair

examples.hanzi: 我有点儿头疼。
examples.pinyin: wǒ yǒudiǎnr tóuténg.
examples.english: I have a slight headache.

examples.hanzi: 他早上起床后先洗头。
examples.pinyin: tā zǎoshang qǐchuáng hòu xiān xǐ tóu.
examples.english: After getting up, he washes his hair first.

头.meaning: top; end; front part (bound form): 山头 hilltop, 烟头 cigarette butt, 床头 head of the bed

examples.hanzi: 不要把烟头扔在地上。
examples.pinyin: bùyào bǎ yāntou rēng zài dì shang.
examples.english: Don't throw cigarette butts on the ground.

头.meaning: measure word for livestock: 一头牛 an ox, 一头猪 a pig

examples.hanzi: 爷爷家养了一头牛。
examples.pinyin: yéye jiā yǎng le yī tóu niú.
examples.english: Grandpa's family keeps an ox.

头.meaning: noun-forming suffix, neutral tone, never standalone: 石头 stone, 馒头 steamed bun, 木头 wood

examples.hanzi: 河边有一块大石头。
examples.pinyin: hébiān yǒu yī kuài dà shítou.
examples.english: There's a big stone by the river.

一会儿.meaning: a little while; a moment: 等一会儿 wait a moment, 休息一会儿 rest a bit; 一会儿…一会儿… now… now…

examples.hanzi: 等一会儿，我马上就来。
examples.pinyin: děng yīhuìr, wǒ mǎshàng jiù lái.
examples.english: Wait a moment, I'll be right there.

examples.hanzi: 他一会儿唱歌，一会儿跳舞。
examples.pinyin: tā yīhuìr chàng gē, yīhuìr tiào wǔ.
examples.english: He sings for a while, then dances for a while.

矮.meaning: short (in height); low (of buildings): 他比我矮 he's shorter than me, 矮房子 a low building

examples.hanzi: 我弟弟比我矮半个头。
examples.pinyin: wǒ dìdi bǐ wǒ ǎi bàn gè tóu.
examples.english: My little brother is half a head shorter than me.

爱人.connotation: neutral in mainland usage; slightly dated among younger urban speakers who prefer 太太/先生 or 老公/老婆
爱人.meaning: spouse; husband or wife: 我爱人 my wife/my husband

examples.hanzi: 我爱人也在银行工作。
examples.pinyin: wǒ àiren yě zài yínháng gōngzuò.
examples.english: My spouse also works at a bank.

安静.meaning: quiet; peaceful: 请安静 please be quiet, 教室里很安静 the classroom is quiet

examples.hanzi: 请大家安静一点儿。
examples.pinyin: qǐng dàjiā ānjìng yīdiǎnr.
examples.english: Please be a bit quieter.

安全.meaning: safe; safety; security: 注意安全 mind your safety, 安全带 seatbelt, 交通安全 traffic safety

examples.hanzi: 过马路的时候要注意安全。
examples.pinyin: guò mǎlù de shíhou yào zhùyì ānquán.
examples.english: Pay attention to safety when crossing the road.

阿姨.meaning: aunt (mother's sister); polite address for a woman of one's mother's generation; housemaid/nanny

examples.hanzi: 阿姨，请问卫生间在哪儿？
examples.pinyin: āyí, qǐngwèn wèishēngjiān zài nǎr?
examples.english: Auntie, where is the restroom, please?

把.meaning: preposition moving the object before the verb for disposal/affectedness: 把门关上 close the door, 把作业做完 finish the homework

examples.hanzi: 出门前把灯关了。
examples.pinyin: chūmén qián bǎ dēng guān le.
examples.english: Turn off the lights before leaving.

examples.hanzi: 请把作业交给老师。
examples.pinyin: qǐng bǎ zuòyè jiāo gěi lǎoshī.
examples.english: Please hand the homework to the teacher.

把.meaning: measure word for things with a handle: 一把刀 a knife, 一把伞 an umbrella, 一把椅子 a chair

examples.hanzi: 他从包里拿出一把伞。
examples.pinyin: tā cóng bāo li ná chū yī bǎ sǎn.
examples.english: He took an umbrella out of his bag.

把.meaning: handle (bound form): 把手 handle; 拉一把 lend a hand — mostly beyond level

examples.hanzi: 这个门的把手坏了。
examples.pinyin: zhège mén de bǎshou huài le.
examples.english: The handle of this door is broken.

办.meaning: to handle; to do; to run; to set up: 办事 handle a matter, 办签证 get a visa, 办学校 found a school

examples.hanzi: 我想办一张新的银行卡。
examples.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng bàn yī zhāng xīn de yínhángkǎ.
examples.english: I'd like to get a new bank card.

搬.meaning: to move; to carry: 搬东西 move things, 搬进来 move in, 把桌子搬上楼 carry the table upstairs

examples.hanzi: 这些箱子太重，我搬不动。
examples.pinyin: zhèxiē xiāngzi tài zhòng, wǒ bān bu dòng.
examples.english: These boxes are too heavy; I can't move them.

办法.meaning: way; means; method; solution: 想办法 think of a way, 没办法 there's no way to do it

examples.hanzi: 别着急，总会有办法的。
examples.pinyin: bié zháojí, zǒng huì yǒu bànfǎ de.
examples.english: Don't worry; there will always be a way.

办公室.meaning: office (measure word 间/个): 在办公室工作 work in the office

examples.hanzi: 老师正在办公室里开会。
examples.pinyin: lǎoshī zhèngzài bàngōngshì li kāi huì.
examples.english: The teacher is having a meeting in the office.

帮助.meaning: to help; to assist; help; assistance: 帮助同学 help one's classmates, 需要帮助 need help

examples.hanzi: 他常常帮助同学学习数学。
examples.pinyin: tā chángcháng bāngzhù tóngxué xuéxí shùxué.
examples.english: He often helps classmates study math.

班级.meaning: class; class group (in school): 班级活动 class activity, 我们班级的同学 the students in our class

examples.hanzi: 我们班级一共有三十个学生。
examples.pinyin: wǒmen bānjí yīgòng yǒu sānshí gè xuésheng.
examples.english: Our class has thirty students in all.

搬家.meaning: to move house: 下个月搬家 moving house next month (separable: 搬了两次家)

examples.hanzi: 他们下个月要搬家。
examples.pinyin: tāmen xià gè yuè yào bānjiā.
examples.english: They're moving house next month.

半天.meaning: half a day; a long while (exaggerated): 等了半天 waited for ages, 说了半天 talked on and on

examples.hanzi: 我等了你半天，你怎么才来？
examples.pinyin: wǒ děng le nǐ bàntiān, nǐ zěnme cái lái?
examples.english: I waited for you ages — why are you only here now?

饱.meaning: full (from eating): 吃饱了 eaten one's fill, 我饱了 I'm full

examples.hanzi: 我吃得很饱，再也吃不下了。
examples.pinyin: wǒ chī de hěn bǎo, zàiyě chī bu xià le.
examples.english: I'm quite full; I can't eat another bite.

报纸.meaning: newspaper (measure word 份/张): 看报纸 read the paper

examples.hanzi: 爷爷每天早上都看报纸。
examples.pinyin: yéye měitiān zǎoshang dōu kàn bàozhǐ.
examples.english: Grandpa reads the newspaper every morning.

被.meaning: passive marker introducing the agent: 他被老师批评了 he was criticized by the teacher; also agentless 不小心被撞了

examples.hanzi: 我的自行车被朋友借走了。
examples.pinyin: wǒ de zìxíngchē bèi péngyou jiè zǒu le.
examples.english: My bike was borrowed by a friend.

被.meaning: quilt (bound form; standalone is 被子): 盖被 tuck in the quilt — beyond level

examples.hanzi: 天冷了，晚上要盖上厚被子。
examples.pinyin: tiān lěng le, wǎnshang yào gài shang hòu bèizi.
examples.english: It's gotten cold; use a thick quilt at night.

北.meaning: north: 往北走 go north, 北边 the north side

examples.hanzi: 从这儿一直往北走就到了。
examples.pinyin: cóng zhèr yīzhí wǎng běi zǒu jiù dào le.
examples.english: Keep walking north from here and you'll get there.

北方.meaning: the north; northern China: 北方冬天很冷 winters are cold in the north

examples.hanzi: 北方冬天常常下雪。
examples.pinyin: běifāng dōngtiān chángcháng xià xuě.
examples.english: It often snows in the north in winter.

变.meaning: to change; to become: 天气变了 the weather changed, 变得更好 become better

examples.hanzi: 这几年这个城市变了很多。
examples.pinyin: zhè jǐ nián zhège chéngshì biàn le hěn duō.
examples.english: This city has changed a lot these past few years.

遍.meaning: measure word for complete rounds of an action: 读三遍 read it three times, 说一遍 say it once

examples.hanzi: 这个字我不认识，请再读一遍。
examples.pinyin: zhège zì wǒ bù rènshi, qǐng zài dú yī biàn.
examples.english: I don't know this character; please read it once more.

变成.meaning: to change into; to become: 水变成了冰 the water turned into ice

examples.hanzi: 天太冷，水都变成了冰。
examples.pinyin: tiān tài lěng, shuǐ dōu biàn chéng le bīng.
examples.english: It's so cold the water has all turned to ice.

变化.meaning: to change; variation; change: 天气变化 weather changes, 变化很大 changed a lot

examples.hanzi: 家乡这几年发生了很大的变化。
examples.pinyin: jiāxiāng zhè jǐ nián fāshēng le hěn dà de biànhuà.
examples.english: My hometown has undergone great changes these past few years.

表演.meaning: to perform; performance: 表演节目 perform an item, 精彩的表演 a wonderful show

examples.hanzi: 晚会上同学们表演了跳舞。
examples.pinyin: wǎnhuì shang tóngxuémen biǎoyǎn le tiào wǔ.
examples.english: At the evening party the students performed a dance.

别的.meaning: other; else: 别的人 other people, 别的地方 somewhere else, 没有别的了 nothing else

examples.hanzi: 我买了苹果、香蕉和别的水果。
examples.pinyin: wǒ mǎi le píngguǒ, xiāngjiāo hé biéde shuǐguǒ.
examples.english: I bought apples, bananas and other fruits.

别人.meaning: others; other people: 别人都知道 everyone else knows, 别影响别人 don't disturb others

examples.hanzi: 在图书馆不要大声影响别人。
examples.pinyin: zài túshūguǎn bùyào dàshēng yǐngxiǎng biérén.
examples.english: Don't disturb others by being loud in the library.

笔记.meaning: notes (taken while listening or reading): 做笔记 take notes, 上课记笔记 take notes in class

examples.hanzi: 上课的时候要多做笔记。
examples.pinyin: shàngkè de shíhou yào duō zuò bǐjì.
examples.english: You should take lots of notes in class.

near_synonyms.difference: 比较 is 'relatively/quite' without a named standard (比较大 fairly big); 更 is explicit increase over something mentioned (今天更冷 even colder than before)

比较.meaning: comparatively; quite: 比较大 relatively big, 今天比较冷 it's rather cold today

examples.hanzi: 今天比较冷，多穿点儿衣服。
examples.pinyin: jīntiān bǐjiào lěng, duō chuān diǎnr yīfu.
examples.english: It's rather cold today; wear more clothes.

examples.hanzi: 南方人吃米饭比较多。
examples.pinyin: nánfāng rén chī mǐfàn bǐjiào duō.
examples.english: Southerners eat relatively more rice.

比较.meaning: to compare: 比较两个方案 compare two plans

examples.hanzi: 请比较一下这两个句子的不同。
examples.pinyin: qǐng bǐjiào yīxià zhè liǎng gè jùzi de bùtóng.
examples.english: Please compare the differences between these two sentences.

笔记本.meaning: notebook (paper); laptop: 笔记本电脑 laptop computer

examples.hanzi: 她把新单词写在笔记本上。
examples.pinyin: tā bǎ xīn dāncí xiě zài bǐjìběn shang.
examples.english: She writes new words in her notebook.

冰.meaning: ice: 冰化了 the ice melted, 一块冰 a lump of ice

examples.hanzi: 天冷了，河上都结了冰。
examples.pinyin: tiān lěng le, hé shang dōu jié le bīng.
examples.english: It's cold; the river has frozen over.

冰激凌.meaning: ice cream (measure word 个/份): 一个冰激凌 an ice cream

examples.hanzi: 夏天孩子都爱吃冰激凌。
examples.pinyin: xiàtiān háizi dōu ài chī bīngjīlíng.
examples.english: In summer children all love eating ice cream.

病人.meaning: patient; sick person: 医院里有很多病人 many patients in the hospital

examples.hanzi: 医生每天都要看很多病人。
examples.pinyin: yīshēng měitiān dōu yào kàn hěn duō bìngrén.
examples.english: Doctors see many patients every day.

宾馆.meaning: hotel: 住宾馆 stay in a hotel, 一家宾馆

examples.hanzi: 我们在学校附近找了一家宾馆。
examples.pinyin: wǒmen zài xuéxiào fùjìn zhǎo le yī jiā bīnguǎn.
examples.english: We found a hotel near the school.

冰箱.meaning: refrigerator; fridge: 把菜放进冰箱 put the vegetables in the fridge

examples.hanzi: 把牛奶放进冰箱里吧。
examples.pinyin: bǎ niúnǎi fàng jìn bīngxiāng li ba.
examples.english: Put the milk in the fridge.

比如.meaning: for example; for instance: 很多水果，比如苹果、香蕉 many fruits — for example apples and bananas

examples.hanzi: 我喜欢很多运动，比如打篮球、游泳。
examples.pinyin: wǒ xǐhuān hěn duō yùndòng, bǐrú dǎ lánqiú, yóuyǒng.
examples.english: I like many sports — for example basketball and swimming.

比赛.meaning: to compete; match; competition: 参加比赛 enter a competition, 篮球比赛 basketball game

examples.hanzi: 我们班和二班比赛篮球。
examples.pinyin: wǒmen bān hé èr bān bǐsài lánqiú.
examples.english: Our class is playing a basketball match against class two.

必须.meaning: must; have to: 必须马上去 must go immediately, 必须完成 must finish

examples.hanzi: 明天早上我必须六点起床。
examples.pinyin: míngtiān zǎoshang wǒ bìxū liù diǎn qǐchuáng.
examples.english: I must get up at six tomorrow morning.

不同.meaning: different; not the same: 不同的国家 different countries, 意见不同 opinions differ

examples.hanzi: 这两个词的意思完全不同。
examples.pinyin: zhè liǎng gè cí de yìsi wánquán bùtóng.
examples.english: These two words have completely different meanings.

不但.meaning: not only… (paired with 而且/也/还): 不但聪明而且努力 not only smart but hardworking

examples.hanzi: 他不但会说汉语，而且会说日语。
examples.pinyin: tā bùdàn huì shuō Hànyǔ, érqiě huì shuō Rìyǔ.
examples.english: He can speak not only Chinese but also Japanese.

不见.meaning: to disappear; to be missing: 钥匙不见了 the keys are gone; set phrase 好久不见 long time no see

examples.hanzi: 我的钥匙不见了。
examples.pinyin: wǒ de yàoshi bújiàn le.
examples.english: My keys have disappeared.

不久.meaning: soon (afterwards); before long: 不久他就走了 before long he left; 不久前 not long ago

examples.hanzi: 他大学毕业不久就找到了工作。
examples.pinyin: tā dàxué bìyè bùjiǔ jiù zhǎodào le gōngzuò.
examples.english: Not long after graduating from university he found a job.

不行.meaning: no good; not okay; won't work: 这个办法不行 this method won't work; 不行！ no way!

examples.hanzi: 这个办法不行，我们再想别的。
examples.pinyin: zhège bànfǎ bùxíng, wǒmen zài xiǎng biéde.
examples.english: This method won't work; let's think of something else.

不用.meaning: no need to; needn't: 不用去 no need to go, 不用谢 don't mention it

examples.hanzi: 我自己能行，不用帮我。
examples.pinyin: wǒ zìjǐ néng xíng, bùyòng bāng wǒ.
examples.english: I can manage; no need to help me.

才1.meaning: not until; as late as (later than expected): 他十点才来 he didn't come until ten

examples.hanzi: 他晚上十二点才做完作业。
examples.pinyin: tā wǎnshang shí'èr diǎn cái zuò wán zuòyè.
examples.english: He didn't finish his homework until midnight.

examples.hanzi: 火车开了三个小时才到北京。
examples.pinyin: huǒchē kāi le sān gè xiǎoshí cái dào Běijīng.
examples.english: The train took three whole hours to reach Beijing.

才1.meaning: only then; only if (with 只有/因为): 只有努力才能成功 only by working hard can you succeed

examples.hanzi: 只有多听多说，才能学好汉语。
examples.pinyin: zhǐyǒu duō tīng duō shuō, cái néng xué hǎo Hànyǔ.
examples.english: Only by listening and speaking a lot can you learn Chinese well.

才1.meaning: merely; only (small amount, disapproving): 才两个人来 only two people came

examples.hanzi: 今天来的人才十个人。
examples.pinyin: jīntiān lái de rén cái shí gè rén.
examples.english: Only ten people came today.

菜单.meaning: menu (restaurant); menu (software): 看菜单 look at the menu

examples.hanzi: 服务员拿来了菜单。
examples.pinyin: fúwùyuán ná lái le càidān.
examples.english: The waiter brought the menu.

参加.meaning: to take part in; to attend; to join: 参加会议 attend a meeting, 参加比赛 enter a competition

examples.hanzi: 我报名参加了学校的运动会。
examples.pinyin: wǒ bàomíng cānjiā le xuéxiào de yùndònghuì.
examples.english: I signed up for the school sports meet.

草.meaning: grass; straw: 一根草 a blade of grass, 牛吃草 cattle eat grass

examples.hanzi: 公园的草长得很高。
examples.pinyin: gōngyuán de cǎo zhǎng de hěn gāo.
examples.english: The grass in the park has grown very tall.

草地.meaning: lawn; grass; grassland: 在草地上坐 sit on the grass

examples.hanzi: 孩子们在草地上玩儿。
examples.pinyin: háizimen zài cǎodì shang wánr.
examples.english: The children are playing on the grass.

层.meaning: measure word for storeys and layers: 三层的房子 a three-storey house, 一层蛋糕 one layer of cake

examples.hanzi: 我家住在三层。
examples.pinyin: wǒ jiā zhù zài sān céng.
examples.english: My home is on the third floor.

examples.hanzi: 这是一个三层的生日蛋糕。
examples.pinyin: zhè shì yī gè sān céng de shēngri dàngāo.
examples.english: This is a three-layer birthday cake.

层.meaning: layer; storey (bound form): 顶层 top floor

examples.hanzi: 电梯坏了，我们只好爬到十层。
examples.pinyin: diàntī huài le, wǒmen zhǐhǎo pá dào shí céng.
examples.english: The elevator was broken, so we had to climb to the tenth floor.

查.meaning: to check; to look up; to examine: 查词典 look it up in a dictionary, 查邮件 check email

examples.hanzi: 遇到不懂的词就查词典。
examples.pinyin: yùdào bù dǒng de cí jiù chá cídiǎn.
examples.english: Look up unfamiliar words in the dictionary.

examples.hanzi: 我每天早上先查一下邮件。
examples.pinyin: wǒ měitiān zǎoshang xiān chá yīxià yóujiàn.
examples.english: Every morning I first check my email.

差.meaning: poor; bad; of low quality: 成绩差 poor grades, 质量差 poor quality

examples.hanzi: 这台手机质量太差了。
examples.pinyin: zhè tái shǒujī zhìliàng tài chà le.
examples.english: This phone's quality is terrible.

差.meaning: to lack; to fall short by; to be short of: 差五分钟五点 five to five, 还差十块 still ten yuan short

examples.hanzi: 现在差五分钟八点。
examples.pinyin: xiànzài chà wǔ fēnzhōng bā diǎn.
examples.english: It's five minutes to eight now.

examples.hanzi: 我还差十块钱。
examples.pinyin: wǒ hái chà shí kuài qián.
examples.english: I'm still ten yuan short.

差.meaning: difference; discrepancy (bound form): 时差 time difference, 相差 differ by

examples.hanzi: 他比我差远了。
examples.pinyin: tā bǐ wǒ chà yuǎn le.
examples.english: He's far worse than me.

差.meaning: to dispatch; errand (bound form): 出差 go on a business trip

examples.hanzi: 北京和纽约有时差。
examples.pinyin: Běijīng hé Niǔyuē yǒu shíchā.
examples.english: Beijing and New York have a time difference.

差不多.meaning: about the same; similar: 两兄弟个子差不多 the brothers are about the same height

examples.hanzi: 两兄弟的个子差不多。
examples.pinyin: liǎng xiōngdì de gèzi chàbuduō.
examples.english: The two brothers are about the same height.

examples.hanzi: 这两件衣服的价格差不多。
examples.pinyin: zhè liǎng jiàn yīfu de jiàgé chàbuduō.
examples.english: These two items of clothing are about the same price.

near_synonyms.difference: 几乎 emphasizes being on the verge (几乎忘了 almost forgot); 差不多 emphasizes 'about/close to' a quantity (差不多十点 about ten o'clock)

差不多.meaning: almost; nearly: 差不多十点了 it's nearly ten, 差不多好了 almost done

examples.hanzi: 我们差不多走了两个小时。
examples.pinyin: wǒmen chàbuduō zǒu le liǎng gè xiǎoshí.
examples.english: We walked for almost two hours.

尝.meaning: to taste: 尝一下 have a taste, 尝尝这个菜 try this dish

examples.hanzi: 妈妈，我来尝尝这个菜。
examples.pinyin: māma, wǒ lái chángchang zhège cài.
examples.english: Mom, let me taste this dish.

常.meaning: often (mostly bound; 常常 more common standalone): 他常来 he often comes

examples.hanzi: 他常来这家餐厅吃饭。
examples.pinyin: tā cháng lái zhè jiā cāntīng chīfàn.
examples.english: He often comes to this restaurant to eat.

常见.meaning: common; commonly seen: 常见问题 frequently asked questions, 很常见 very common

examples.hanzi: 这种问题在考试中很常见。
examples.pinyin: zhè zhǒng wèntí zài kǎoshì zhōng hěn chángjiàn.
examples.english: This kind of question is common in exams.

常用.meaning: commonly used; in common use: 常用字 common characters

examples.hanzi: 这是汉语里最常用的二百个字。
examples.pinyin: zhè shì Hànyǔ lǐ zuì chángyòng de èrbǎi gè zì.
examples.english: These are the two hundred most commonly used Chinese characters.

near_synonyms.difference: 经常 and 常常 both mean 'often' and mostly interchange; 经常 leans slightly written, 常常 colloquial. Negation uses 不常, not 不常常

常常.meaning: often; frequently: 常常去公园 often go to the park (negative uses 不常, not 不常常)

examples.hanzi: 周末他常常去公园打球。
examples.pinyin: zhōumò tā chángcháng qù gōngyuán dǎ qiú.
examples.english: On weekends he often goes to the park to play ball.

成绩.meaning: result; grades; score: 考试成绩 exam results, 成绩很好 good grades

examples.hanzi: 这次考试他的成绩很好。
examples.pinyin: zhè cì kǎoshì tā de chéngjì hěn hǎo.
examples.english: He got good results on this exam.

城市.meaning: city (measure word 座): 大城市 big city, 住在城市 live in a city

examples.hanzi: 上海是中国最大的城市之一。
examples.pinyin: Shànghǎi shì Zhōngguó zuì dà de chéngshì zhī yī.
examples.english: Shanghai is one of China's largest cities.

衬衫.meaning: shirt (measure word 件): 一件白衬衫 a white shirt

examples.hanzi: 他穿了一件白衬衫。
examples.pinyin: tā chuān le yī jiàn bái chènshān.
examples.english: He wore a white shirt.

迟到.meaning: to be late (for): 上课迟到 be late for class, 他又迟到了 he's late again

examples.hanzi: 对不起，我又迟到了。
examples.pinyin: duìbuqǐ, wǒ yòu chídào le.
examples.english: Sorry, I'm late again.

船.meaning: boat; ship (measure word 条/艘): 坐船 travel by boat

examples.hanzi: 我们坐船过河。
examples.pinyin: wǒmen zuò chuán guò hé.
examples.english: We crossed the river by boat.

出发.meaning: to set out; to set off: 明天出发 set off tomorrow, 从北京出发 depart from Beijing

examples.hanzi: 我们明天早上七点出发去机场。
examples.pinyin: wǒmen míngtiān zǎoshang qī diǎn chūfā qù jīchǎng.
examples.english: We set off for the airport at seven tomorrow morning.

除了.meaning: except; besides (with 都/也/还): 除了他都来了 everyone came except him; 除了汉语，还学英语 besides Chinese, (I) also study English

examples.hanzi: 除了小明，大家都来了。
examples.pinyin: chúle Xiǎomíng, dàjiā dōu lái le.
examples.english: Everyone came except Xiaoming.

examples.hanzi: 除了汉语，他还学英语。
examples.pinyin: chúle Hànyǔ, tā hái xué Yīngyǔ.
examples.english: Besides Chinese, he also studies English.

春天.meaning: spring: 春天来了 spring has come

examples.hanzi: 春天公园里开满了花。
examples.pinyin: chūntiān gōngyuán lǐ kāi mǎn le huā.
examples.english: In spring the park is full of flowers.

出生.meaning: to be born: 他出生在上海 he was born in Shanghai

examples.hanzi: 他出生在一个小城市。
examples.pinyin: tā chūshēng zài yī gè xiǎo chéngshì.
examples.english: He was born in a small city.

出院.meaning: to be discharged from hospital: 爷爷出院了 grandpa is out of hospital

examples.hanzi: 奶奶病好了，明天就出院。
examples.pinyin: nǎinai bìng hǎo le, míngtiān jiù chū yuàn.
examples.english: Grandma has recovered and leaves hospital tomorrow.

初中.meaning: junior middle school: 上初中 attend junior high

examples.hanzi: 他儿子今年上初中了。
examples.pinyin: tā érzi jīnnián shàng chūzhōng le.
examples.english: His son started junior high this year.

词典.meaning: dictionary (of words; a 字典 lists characters): 查词典 consult a dictionary

examples.hanzi: 这是老师推荐我们用的汉语词典。
examples.pinyin: zhè shì lǎoshī tuījiàn wǒmen yòng de Hànyǔ cídiǎn.
examples.english: This is the Chinese dictionary the teacher recommends.

聪明.meaning: smart; clever: 聪明的孩子 a clever child

examples.hanzi: 这孩子很聪明，什么一听就懂。
examples.pinyin: zhè háizi hěn cōngming, shénme yī tīng jiù dǒng.
examples.english: This child is smart — understands everything on first hearing.

near_synonyms.difference: 可能 weighs likelihood of an event (可能下雨 it may rain); 大概 is a confident rough estimate (大概五点 around five)

大概.meaning: probably; presumably: 大概要下雨了 it'll probably rain

examples.hanzi: 他大概忘了今天的会议。
examples.pinyin: tā dàgài wàng le jīntiān de huìyì.
examples.english: He has probably forgotten today's meeting.

大概.meaning: approximate; rough idea: 大概的数字 an approximate figure, 只知道个大概 only know the rough idea

examples.hanzi: 我只知道个大概，具体情况你问他。
examples.pinyin: wǒ zhǐ zhīdào gè dàgài, jùtǐ qíngkuàng nǐ wèn tā.
examples.english: I only know the general idea; ask him for details.

near_synonyms.difference: 拿 is holding in the hand (拿筷子 hold chopsticks); 带 is carrying/bringing along (带伞 bring an umbrella)

带.meaning: to bring; to take along; to carry: 带伞 bring an umbrella, 带孩子去公园 take the kids to the park

examples.hanzi: 今天有雨，记得带伞。
examples.pinyin: jīntiān yǒu yǔ, jìde dài sǎn.
examples.english: It will rain today; remember to bring an umbrella.

带.meaning: to lead; to show the way: 请带他去办公室 please take him to the office

examples.hanzi: 我不认识路，请带我去银行。
examples.pinyin: wǒ bù rènshi lù, qǐng dài wǒ qù yínháng.
examples.english: I don't know the way; please take me to the bank.

带.meaning: belt; band; zone (bound form): 皮带 leather belt, 这一带 this area

examples.hanzi: 他系了一条新皮带。
examples.pinyin: tā jì le yī tiáo xīn pídài.
examples.english: He wore a new leather belt.

蛋糕.meaning: cake: 生日蛋糕 birthday cake, 一块蛋糕 a slice of cake

examples.hanzi: 妈妈给我买了一个生日蛋糕。
examples.pinyin: māma gěi wǒ mǎi le yī gè shēngri dàngāo.
examples.english: Mom bought me a birthday cake.

当然.meaning: of course; certainly: 当然可以 of course, 当然想去 certainly want to go

examples.hanzi: 你可以用我的自行车，当然没问题。
examples.pinyin: nǐ kěyǐ yòng wǒ de zìxíngchē, dāngrán méi wèntí.
examples.english: You can use my bike — of course, no problem.

near_synonyms.difference: 着急 is acute anxiety or impatience about something now (急得走不动); 担心 is ongoing worry about a person or outcome (担心他的身体)

担心.meaning: to worry (about): 担心他的健康 worry about his health, 别担心 don't worry

examples.hanzi: 别担心，我会照顾好自己的。
examples.pinyin: bié dānxīn, wǒ huì zhàogù hǎo zìjǐ de.
examples.english: Don't worry; I'll take good care of myself.

到处.meaning: everywhere; all over: 到处都是人 there are people everywhere, 到处找 looked everywhere

examples.hanzi: 节日的时候，到处都是人。
examples.pinyin: jiérì de shíhou, dàochù dōu shì rén.
examples.english: During festivals there are people everywhere.

大人.meaning: adult; grown-up: 大人和孩子 adults and children

examples.hanzi: 这个游戏孩子和大人都能玩儿。
examples.pinyin: zhège yóuxì háizi hé dàren dōu néng wánr.
examples.english: Children and adults can both play this game.

打扫.meaning: to clean; to sweep: 打扫房间 clean the room, 打扫卫生 do some cleaning

examples.hanzi: 周末我们在宿舍打扫卫生。
examples.pinyin: zhōumò wǒmen zài sùshè dǎsǎo wèishēng.
examples.english: On weekends we clean the dorm.

打算.meaning: to plan; to intend; plan: 打算去旅行 plan to travel, 有什么打算 what plans do you have

examples.hanzi: 暑假我打算去旅行。
examples.pinyin: shǔjià wǒ dǎsuan qù lǚxíng.
examples.english: I plan to travel during summer vacation.

大小.meaning: size: 房间的大小 the size of the room, 大小不同 different sizes

examples.hanzi: 这两件衬衫的大小不一样。
examples.pinyin: zhè liǎng jiàn chènshān de dàxiǎo bù yīyàng.
examples.english: These two shirts are different sizes.

大熊猫.meaning: giant panda (measure word 只): 大熊猫吃竹子 pandas eat bamboo

examples.hanzi: 大熊猫最喜欢吃竹子。
examples.pinyin: dàxióngmāo zuì xǐhuān chī zhúzi.
examples.english: Giant pandas love eating bamboo most.

大衣.meaning: overcoat (measure word 件): 穿上大衣 put on one's coat

examples.hanzi: 外面很冷，穿上大衣吧。
examples.pinyin: wàimiàn hěn lěng, chuān shang dàyī ba.
examples.english: It's cold outside; put on your coat.

得.meaning: structural particle marking a degree/manner complement after a verb or adjective: 跑得快 run fast, 好得很 very good

examples.hanzi: 他跑得很快。
examples.pinyin: tā pǎo de hěn kuài.
examples.english: He runs very fast.

examples.hanzi: 这个电影好得很。
examples.pinyin: zhège diànyǐng hǎo de hěn.
examples.english: This movie is really good.

near_synonyms.difference: 必须 is objective obligation (必须戴口罩 masks are required); 得 děi is colloquial personal necessity (我得走了 I've got to go)

得.meaning: to have to; must: 我得走了 I have to go, 你得早点儿起 you have to get up early

examples.hanzi: 太晚了，我得走了。
examples.pinyin: tài wǎn le, wǒ děi zǒu le.
examples.english: It's too late; I have to go.

得.meaning: to get; to obtain (mostly bound: 得到, 得分, 得奖): 得了第一名 won first place

examples.hanzi: 他比赛得了第一名。
examples.pinyin: tā bǐsài dé le dì-yī míng.
examples.english: He won first place in the competition.

得到.meaning: to get; to obtain; to receive: 得到帮助 receive help, 得到消息 get the news

examples.hanzi: 他的努力得到了大家的认可。
examples.pinyin: tā de nǔlì dédào le dàjiā de rènkě.
examples.english: His efforts won everyone's approval.

得分.meaning: to score; score: 得了十分 scored ten points, 最后得分 the final score

examples.hanzi: 这场比赛他得分最多。
examples.pinyin: zhè chǎng bǐsài tā défēn zuì duō.
examples.english: He scored the most in this game.

的话.meaning: if-clause marker after a stated condition: 明天不下雨的话，我们就去 if it doesn't rain tomorrow we'll go

examples.hanzi: 明天你要是有空的话，来我家吃饭。
examples.pinyin: míngtiān nǐ yàoshi yǒu kòng de huà, lái wǒ jiā chīfàn.
examples.english: If you're free tomorrow, come to my place for dinner.

灯.meaning: lamp; light: 开灯 turn on the light, 关灯 turn off the light (measure word 盏)

examples.hanzi: 睡觉前记得关灯。
examples.pinyin: shujiào qián jìde guān dēng.
examples.english: Remember to turn off the light before bed.

near_synonyms.difference: 的 links a modifier to a noun (漂亮的房子 a beautiful house); 地 links a modifier to a verb (慢慢地走 walk slowly)

地.meaning: adverbial particle before a verb phrase: 慢慢地走 walk slowly, 认真地学习 study hard

examples.hanzi: 他慢慢地走进了教室。
examples.pinyin: tā mànmàn de zǒu jìn le jiàoshì.
examples.english: He slowly walked into the classroom.

地.meaning: ground; earth; land: 地上 on the ground; bound form in 地方, 地图, 地址

examples.hanzi: 地上有一张纸。
examples.pinyin: dì shang yǒu yī zhāng zhǐ.
examples.english: There's a sheet of paper on the ground.

电.meaning: electricity; power: 停电了 the power's out; bound form in 电话, 电脑, 电梯

examples.hanzi: 昨天晚上我们这儿停电了。
examples.pinyin: zuótiān wǎnshang wǒmen zhèr tíngdiàn le.
examples.english: Our power went out last night.

电梯.meaning: elevator; lift: 坐电梯 take the elevator, 电梯坏了 the elevator is broken

examples.hanzi: 请坐电梯到五层。
examples.pinyin: qǐng zuò diàntī dào wǔ céng.
examples.english: Please take the elevator to the fifth floor.

电子书.meaning: e-book: 用手机看电子书 read e-books on the phone

examples.hanzi: 我现在更喜欢在手机上看电子书。
examples.pinyin: wǒ xiànzài gèng xǐhuān zài shǒujī shang kàn diànzǐshū.
examples.english: Now I prefer reading e-books on my phone.

地点.meaning: place; location; venue: 开会地点 meeting venue

examples.hanzi: 请把比赛的地点和时间写在黑板上。
examples.pinyin: qǐng bǎ bǐsài de dìdiǎn hé shíjiān xiě zài hēibǎn shang.
examples.english: Please write the match's venue and time on the blackboard.

地方.meaning: place; spot: 好玩的地方 fun places, 这个地方 this place

examples.hanzi: 这个季节是旅游的好地方。
examples.pinyin: zhège jìjié shì lǚyóu de hǎo dìfang.
examples.english: This place is a good travel spot in this season.

地方.meaning: part; respect (of speech or writing): 他说的有地方不对 some of what he said is wrong

examples.hanzi: 他说的话有地方我不太懂。
examples.pinyin: tā shuō de huà yǒu dìfang wǒ bù tài dǒng.
examples.english: There are parts of what he said I don't quite understand.

地图.meaning: map: 查地图 check the map, 一张地图 a map

examples.hanzi: 我们在手机上看地图找路。
examples.pinyin: wǒmen zài shǒujī shang kàn dìtú zhǎo lù.
examples.english: We looked at the map on the phone to find the way.

丢.meaning: to lose (something): 手机丢了 the phone is lost, 丢了工作 lost one's job

examples.hanzi: 在地铁上我把钱包丢了。
examples.pinyin: zài dìtiě shang wǒ bǎ qiánbāo diū le.
examples.english: I lost my wallet on the subway.

丢.connotation: 'throw' sense is southern/colloquial; standard Mandarin prefers 扔
丢.meaning: to throw (regional/colloquial for 扔): 别乱丢垃圾 don't litter

examples.hanzi: 请不要把垃圾丢在地上。
examples.pinyin: qǐng bùyào bǎ lājī diū zài dì shang.
examples.english: Please don't drop litter on the ground.

examples.hanzi: 太阳从东边升起来。
examples.pinyin: tàiyáng cóng dōngbiān shēng qǐlái.
examples.english: The sun rises in the east.

东北.meaning: northeast; Northeast China: 东北的冬天很冷 winters in the Northeast are very cold

examples.hanzi: 东北的冬天非常冷。

明白.meaning: clear; to understand: 我明白了 I get it, 说得更明白些 explain more clearly

examples.pinyin: nǐ míngbai wǒ de yìsi ma?
examples.english: Do you understand what I mean?

名单.meaning: name list; roster: 获奖名单 winners list, 名单上有他 his name is on the list

examples.hanzi: 老师念了一下获奖名单。
examples.pinyin: lǎoshī niàn le yīxià huòjiǎng míngdān.
examples.english: The teacher read out the winners' list.

名人.meaning: famous person; celebrity: 一位体育名人 a sports celebrity

examples.hanzi: 这条街上有很多名人的家。
examples.pinyin: zhè tiáo jiē shang yǒu hěn duō míngrén de jiā.
examples.english: Many famous people's homes are on this street.

南.meaning: south: 往南走 go south, 南边 the south side

examples.hanzi: 窗户朝南，屋里很亮。
examples.pinyin: chuānghu cháo nán, wū lǐ hěn liàng.
examples.english: The window faces south; the room is bright.

near_synonyms.difference: 难 states difficulty directly (很难 very hard); 不容易 softens it (学外语不容易 learning a foreign language isn't easy)

难.meaning: difficult; hard: 汉语很难 Chinese is hard, 这道题难 this problem is difficult

examples.hanzi: 这道题很难，我不会做。
examples.pinyin: zhè dào tí hěn nán, wǒ bù huì zuò.
examples.english: This problem is hard; I can't do it.

难.meaning: disaster; calamity (bound form 灾难, 遇难): 灾难 disaster — beyond level

examples.hanzi: 这场灾难让很多人失去了家。
examples.pinyin: zhè chǎng zāinàn ràng hěn duō rén shīqù le jiā.
examples.english: This disaster left many people homeless.

南方.meaning: the south; southern China: 南方人 southerner, 南方天气热 the south is hot

examples.hanzi: 南方人冬天不用穿那么厚。
examples.pinyin: nánfāng rén dōngtiān búyòng chuān nàme hòu.
examples.english: Southerners don't need such thick clothes in winter.

near_synonyms.difference: 伤心 is acute grief, often with crying (伤心地哭了); 难过 is a milder, more general sadness or feeling bad

难过.meaning: sad; upset: 心里很难过 feel very sad, 听到消息很难过 was saddened by the news

examples.hanzi: 小狗死了，孩子难过了好几天。
examples.pinyin: xiǎo gǒu sǐ le, háizi nánguò le hǎo jǐ tiān.
examples.english: The puppy died and the child was sad for days.

难过.meaning: hard to get through (of days/life): 这日子难过 — same characters, life is hard sense

examples.hanzi: 丢了工作，日子很难过。
examples.pinyin: diū le gōngzuò, rìzi hěn nánguò.
examples.english: After losing the job, life is very hard.

难看.meaning: ugly; unsightly: 这件衣服真难看 these clothes are really ugly, 字写得太难看 the handwriting is terrible

examples.hanzi: 这件衣服的颜色真难看。
examples.pinyin: zhè jiàn yīfu de yánsè zhēn nànkàn.
examples.english: This clothing's color is really ugly.

男人.meaning: man; men: 那个男人是谁? who is that man?

examples.hanzi: 那个男人是谁？
examples.pinyin: nàge nánrén shì shéi?
examples.english: Who is that man?

男生.meaning: boy (student); schoolboy: 班里的男生 the boys in the class

examples.hanzi: 我们班男生比女生多。
examples.pinyin: wǒmen bān nánshēng bǐ nǚshēng duō.
examples.english: Our class has more boys than girls.

难题.meaning: difficult problem (exam question or abstract): 一道难题 a hard problem, 解决难题 crack a hard problem

examples.hanzi: 老师给我们留了两道难题。
examples.pinyin: lǎoshī gěi wǒmen liú le liǎng dào nántí.
examples.english: The teacher left us two hard problems.

难听.meaning: unpleasant to hear; ugly-sounding: 歌很难听 the song sounds awful, 说得难听 to put it bluntly

examples.hanzi: 他唱歌太难听了。
examples.pinyin: tā chàng gē tài nántīng le.
examples.english: His singing is awful.

年级.meaning: grade (in school): 三年级学生 a third-grade student, 同年级 same grade

examples.hanzi: 我妹妹上三年级。
examples.pinyin: wǒ mèimei shàng sān niánjí.
examples.english: My little sister is in third grade.

年轻.meaning: young: 年轻人 young person, 他看起来很年轻 he looks young

examples.hanzi: 他虽然六十岁了，看起来还很年轻。
examples.pinyin: tā suīrán liùshí suì le, kàn qǐlái hái hěn niánqīng.
examples.english: Although he's sixty, he still looks young.

牛.meaning: cattle; ox; cow (measure word 头): 一头牛 an ox, 牛奶 milk (bound)

examples.hanzi: 田里有两头牛。
examples.pinyin: tián lǐ yǒu liǎng tóu niú.
examples.english: There are two oxen in the field.

牛.meaning: awesome; impressive (slang, 好牛/牛气): 他太牛了 he's amazing

examples.hanzi: 他才学了半年汉语，说得这么好，真牛！
examples.pinyin: tā cái xué le bàn nián Hànyǔ, shuō de zhème hǎo, zhēn niú!
examples.english: He's only studied Chinese half a year and speaks so well — awesome!

努力.meaning: hardworking; making an effort (adjectival: 工作很努力 works hard; adverbial: 努力学习 study hard)

examples.hanzi: 他学习很努力，进步很快。
examples.pinyin: tā xuéxí hěn nǔlì, jìnbù hěn kuài.
examples.english: He studies hard and is improving fast.

努力.meaning: to strive (formal): 努力完成任务 strive to complete the task

examples.hanzi: 公司正在努力完成任务。
examples.pinyin: gōngsī zhèngzài nǔlì wánchéng rènwu.
examples.english: The company is striving to complete the task.

女人.meaning: woman; women: 一个女人 a woman

examples.hanzi: 那个女人在找什么东西。
examples.pinyin: nàge nǚrén zài zhǎo shénme dōngxi.
examples.english: That woman is looking for something.

女生.meaning: girl (student); schoolgirl: 女生宿舍 girls' dormitory

examples.hanzi: 女生宿舍在那边。
examples.pinyin: nǚshēng sùshè zài nàbiān.
examples.english: The girls' dormitory is over there.

爬.meaning: to climb; to crawl: 爬山 climb a mountain, 爬起来 crawl up/get up

examples.hanzi: 我们爬到山顶看日出。
examples.pinyin: wǒmen pá dào shāndǐng kàn rìchū.
examples.english: We climbed to the mountaintop to watch the sunrise.

怕.meaning: to fear; to be afraid of; to be worried that: 不怕困难 not afraid of difficulty, 我怕迟到 I'm worried I'll be late

examples.hanzi: 小时候我怕黑，睡觉要开灯。
examples.pinyin: xiǎoshíhou wǒ pà hēi, shuìjiào yào kāi dēng.
examples.english: As a child I feared the dark and slept with the light on.

怕.meaning: perhaps (I) afraid; conditional fear marker 怕是/恐怕: 恐怕不行 I'm afraid not — bound in 恐怕

examples.hanzi: 今天恐怕会下雨，带把伞吧。
examples.pinyin: jīntiān kǒngpà huì xiàyǔ, dài bǎ sǎn ba.
examples.english: I'm afraid it may rain today; bring an umbrella.

拍照.meaning: to take a photo: 帮我拍照 take a photo for me — separable: 拍张照

examples.hanzi: 这个楼太漂亮了，我们在这儿拍照吧。
examples.pinyin: zhège lóu tài piàoliang le, wǒmen zài zhèr pāizhào ba.
examples.english: This building is so beautiful; let's take a photo here.

胖.connotation: direct; can sound blunt — soften with 一点儿/有点儿
胖.meaning: fat; plump: 他有点儿胖 he's a bit chubby

examples.hanzi: 最近吃得多运动少，我胖了两公斤。
examples.pinyin: zuìjìn chī de duō yùndòng shǎo, wǒ pàng le liǎng gōngjīn.
examples.english: Eating lots and moving little lately, I've gained two kilos.

盘子.meaning: plate; dish; tray: 一个盘子 a plate, 把菜盛在盘子里 put the food on a plate

examples.hanzi: 请把盘子端到厨房去。
examples.pinyin: qǐng bǎ pánzi duān dào chúfáng qù.
examples.english: Please carry the plates to the kitchen.

啤酒.meaning: beer (measure word 杯/瓶/罐): 一瓶啤酒 a bottle of beer

examples.hanzi: 夏天他喜欢喝冰啤酒。
examples.pinyin: xiàtiān tā xǐhuān hē bīng píjiǔ.
examples.english: In summer he likes drinking cold beer.

平时.meaning: ordinarily; usually: 平时很忙 usually busy, 平时几点起床 what time do you usually get up?

examples.hanzi: 平时他六点起床，周末睡到九点。
examples.pinyin: píngshí tā liù diǎn qǐchuáng, zhōumò shuì dào jiǔ diǎn.
examples.english: Normally he gets up at six; on weekends he sleeps till nine.

瓶子.meaning: bottle; jar: 一个瓶子 a bottle, 玻璃瓶子 glass bottle

examples.hanzi: 把这些空瓶子拿去回收。
examples.pinyin: bǎ zhèxiē kōng píngzi ná qù huíshōu.
examples.english: Take these empty bottles for recycling.

骑.meaning: to ride (bicycle, horse, motorcycle): 骑自行车 ride a bike, 骑马 ride a horse

examples.hanzi: 他每天骑车上学。
examples.pinyin: tā měitiān qí chē shàngxué.
examples.english: He bikes to school every day.

起.meaning: to rise; to get up: 起床 get up, 站起来 stand up; early: 起得很早 got up early

examples.hanzi: 早上起得太早，中午困得很。
examples.pinyin: zǎoshang qǐ de tài zǎo, zhōngwǔ kùn de hěn.
examples.english: Got up too early; terribly sleepy at noon.

起.meaning: to start; to begin (起头); to build 起房子 — mostly bound beyond level

examples.hanzi: 这条路起于城中心。
examples.pinyin: zhè tiáo lù qǐ yú chéng zhōngxīn.
examples.english: This road begins in the city center.

起.meaning: measure word for occurrences/cases (colloquial 一起事故 an incident; formal legal use)

examples.hanzi: 这起事故没有人受伤。
examples.pinyin: zhè qǐ shìgù méiyǒu rén shòushāng.
examples.english: No one was hurt in this accident.

铅笔.meaning: pencil (measure word 支): 一支铅笔 a pencil, 用铅笔写 write in pencil

examples.hanzi: 考试答题要用铅笔。
examples.pinyin: kǎoshì dátí yào yòng qiānbǐ.
examples.english: Use a pencil to answer the exam.

前年.meaning: the year before last: 前年他来的 he came the year before last

examples.hanzi: 前年我们去过一次北京。
examples.pinyin: qiánnián wǒmen qù guo yī cì Běijīng.
examples.english: We went to Beijing once the year before last.

前天.meaning: the day before yesterday: 前天很冷 it was cold the day before yesterday

examples.hanzi: 前天下了大雨。
examples.pinyin: qiántiān xià le dà yǔ.
examples.english: It rained heavily the day before yesterday.

汽车.meaning: car; automobile (measure word 辆): 开汽车 drive a car, 坐汽车 take the car/bus

examples.hanzi: 爸爸开汽车送我上学。
examples.pinyin: bàba kāi qìchē sòng wǒ shàngxué.
examples.english: Dad drives me to school.

起飞.meaning: to take off (a plane): 飞机十点起飞 the plane takes off at ten

examples.hanzi: 飞机九点准时起飞。
examples.pinyin: fēijī jiǔ diǎn zhǔnshí qǐfēi.
examples.english: The plane takes off at nine sharp.

奇怪.meaning: strange; odd; surprising: 真奇怪 how strange, 奇怪的声音 a strange noise

examples.hanzi: 真奇怪，门明明锁了，怎么开了？
examples.pinyin: zhēn qíguài, mén míngmíng suǒ le, zěnme kāi le?
examples.english: Strange — the door was clearly locked; how is it open?

奇怪.meaning: to wonder (at/why): 我很奇怪他为什么没来 I wonder why he didn't come

examples.hanzi: 我很奇怪他为什么没来。
examples.pinyin: wǒ hěn qíguài tā wèishénme méi lái.
examples.english: I wonder why he didn't come.

清楚.meaning: clear: 看清楚 see clearly, 说清楚 explain clearly, 图片很清楚 the picture is clear

examples.hanzi: 请再说一遍，我没听清楚。
examples.pinyin: qǐng zài shuō yī biàn, wǒ méi tīng qīngchu.
examples.english: Please say it again; I didn't hear it clearly.

请假.meaning: to ask for leave: 向老师请假 ask the teacher for leave — separable: 请了两天假

examples.hanzi: 他病了，向老师请假。
examples.pinyin: tā bìng le, xiàng lǎoshī qǐngjià.
examples.english: He was sick and asked the teacher for leave.

请客.meaning: to invite people to a meal and pay for it; to stand treat: 今天我请客 it's my treat today (separable: 请了一次客)

examples.hanzi: 今天我生日，我请客。
examples.pinyin: jīntiān wǒ shēngri, wǒ qǐng kè.
examples.english: It's my birthday today — my treat.

其实.meaning: actually; in fact: 其实很简单 it's actually quite simple, 其实他不知道 in fact he doesn't know

examples.hanzi: 他看起来很严肃，其实人很好。
examples.pinyin: tā kàn qǐlái hěn yánsù, qíshí rén hěn hǎo.
examples.english: He looks stern, but actually he's very kind.

near_synonyms.difference: 别的 is colloquial singular-ish 'other/else' (别的地方); 其他 covers 'the rest/others' and is slightly more formal; largely interchangeable at this level

其他.meaning: other; the rest: 其他同学 the other students, 其他的事 other matters

examples.hanzi: 其他同学都已经到了。
examples.pinyin: qítā tóngxué dōu yǐjīng dào le.
examples.english: The other students have all arrived.

球场.meaning: ball field/court: 网球场 tennis court, 在球场上打球 play on the court

examples.hanzi: 放学后我们去球场打篮球。
examples.pinyin: fàngxué hòu wǒmen qù qiúchǎng dǎ lánqiú.
examples.english: After school we go to the court to play basketball.

秋天.meaning: autumn; fall: 秋天叶子黄了 in autumn the leaves turn yellow

examples.hanzi: 秋天的北京最美。
examples.pinyin: qiūtiān de Běijīng zuì měi.
examples.english: Beijing is most beautiful in autumn.

裙子.meaning: skirt (measure word 条): 一条裙子 a skirt, 穿裙子 wear a skirt

examples.hanzi: 她买了一条新裙子。
examples.pinyin: tā mǎi le yī tiáo xīn qúnzi.
examples.english: She bought a new skirt.

near_synonyms.difference: 然后 connects planned successive actions (先…然后…); 以后 marks time after an event (下课以后 after class)

然后.meaning: then; after that: 先吃饭，然后写作业 eat first, then do homework

examples.hanzi: 我们先吃早饭，然后去公园。
examples.pinyin: wǒmen xiān chī zǎofàn, ránhòu qù gōngyuán.
examples.english: We'll eat breakfast first, then go to the park.

near_synonyms.difference: 认得 is recognizing by sight (认得这个字 recognize this character); 认识 also means being acquainted with a person (我认识他 I know him)

认得.meaning: to recognize (a person or character): 我认得他 I recognize him, 认得这个字 recognize this character (knowing by sight; 认识 also 'be acquainted with')

examples.hanzi: 十年没见，我还是一眼认得他。
examples.pinyin: shí nián méi jiàn, wǒ háishì yīyǎn rènde tā.
examples.english: After ten years I still recognized him at a glance.

near_synonyms.difference: 觉得 is everyday 'I feel/think' (我觉得冷); 认为 states a considered judgment (我认为你是对的)

认为.meaning: to think; to believe; to hold the opinion: 我认为你是对的 I think you're right (judgment; 想/觉得 more colloquial)

examples.hanzi: 我认为他的说法不对。
examples.pinyin: wǒ rènwéi tā de shuōfǎ bù duì.
examples.english: I think his claim is wrong.

认真.meaning: conscientious; serious; earnest: 工作认真 works conscientiously, 认真听讲 listen carefully

examples.hanzi: 他上课很认真，笔记记得特别全。
examples.pinyin: tā shàngkè hěn rènzhēn, bǐjì jì de tèbié quán.
examples.english: He's serious in class and takes very complete notes.

热情.meaning: warm; enthusiastic; warmth; enthusiasm: 热情的人 a warm-hearted person, 对客人很热情 very warm to guests

examples.hanzi: 店主热情地招呼每一位客人。
examples.pinyin: diànzhǔ rèqíng de zhāohu měi yī wèi kèren.
examples.english: The shopkeeper warmly greets every customer.

near_synonyms.difference: 简单 means not complicated (简单的道理); 容易 means easy to do (容易学 easy to learn)

容易.meaning: easy; likely to: 这个问题容易 this question is easy, 容易感冒 catch colds easily

examples.hanzi: 这道题容易，大家都会做。
examples.pinyin: zhè dào tí róngyì, dàjiā dōu huì zuò.
examples.english: This problem is easy; everyone can do it.

如果.meaning: if: 如果明天下雨，就不去 if it rains tomorrow we won't go

examples.hanzi: 如果明天天气好，我们就去爬山。
examples.pinyin: rúguǒ míngtiān tiānqì hǎo, wǒmen jiù qù páshān.
examples.english: If the weather is good tomorrow, we'll go hiking.

伞.meaning: umbrella (measure word 把): 下雨了，带伞 it's raining, take an umbrella

examples.hanzi: 要下雨了，快带上伞。
examples.pinyin: yào xiàyǔ le, kuài dài shang sǎn.
examples.english: It's about to rain; take an umbrella.

扫.meaning: to sweep; to scan: 扫地 sweep the floor, 扫码 scan the QR code

examples.hanzi: 值日生负责扫地。
examples.pinyin: zhírìshēng fùzé sǎo dì.
examples.english: The student on duty is responsible for sweeping.

沙发.meaning: sofa (measure word 个/张): 坐在沙发上 sit on the sofa

examples.hanzi: 客厅里放着一张旧沙发。
examples.pinyin: kètīng lǐ fàng zhe yī zhāng jiù shāfā.
examples.english: An old sofa sits in the living room.

山.meaning: mountain; hill (measure word 座): 一座山 a mountain, 爬山 climb a mountain

examples.hanzi: 远处的高山上还有雪。
examples.pinyin: yuǎnchù de gāo shān shang hái yǒu xuě.
examples.english: There's still snow on the distant high mountains.

上衣.meaning: jacket; top (upper-body garment, measure word 件): 一件上衣 a jacket

examples.hanzi: 他把上衣挂在门后。
examples.pinyin: tā bǎ shàngyī guà zài mén hòu.
examples.english: He hung his jacket behind the door.

勺子.meaning: spoon; ladle: 一个勺子 a spoon, 用勺子喝汤 eat soup with a spoon

examples.hanzi: 小孩子用勺子吃饭。
examples.pinyin: xiǎo háizi yòng sháozi chīfàn.
examples.english: Little children eat with a spoon.

身边.meaning: at/by one's side: 孩子身边 the child's side, 我身边有很多朋友 I have many friends around me

examples.hanzi: 他身边总带着一本书。
examples.pinyin: tā shēnbiān zǒng dài zhe yī běn shū.
examples.english: He always has a book at his side.

声.meaning: sound; voice; measure word for sounds: 一声 a sound, 大声叫 shout loudly, 电话里他的声音 his voice on the phone

examples.hanzi: 门外传来敲门声。
examples.pinyin: mén wài chuán lái qiāomén shēng.
examples.english: A knock came from outside the door.

身高.meaning: height (of a person): 他身高一米八 he is 1.8 meters tall

examples.hanzi: 哥哥身高一米九。
examples.pinyin: gēge shēngāo yī mǐ jiǔ.
examples.english: My older brother is 1.9 meters tall.

生活.meaning: life; livelihood; to live: 生活水平 living standard, 他在中国生活 he lives in China, 日常生活 daily life

examples.hanzi: 在中国的生活很愉快。
examples.pinyin: zài Zhōngguó de shēnghuó hěn yúkuài.
examples.english: Life in China is very pleasant.

生气.meaning: to get angry; angry: 别生气 don't be angry, 他很生气 he's very angry — separable: 生他的气 be angry at him

examples.hanzi: 别为这点儿小事生气。
examples.pinyin: bié wèi zhè diǎnr xiǎo shì shēngqì.
examples.english: Don't get angry over such a small thing.

声音.meaning: sound; voice; noise: 声音很大 very loud, 他的声音好听 his voice is pleasant

examples.hanzi: 她的声音很好听。
examples.pinyin: tā de shēngyīn hěn hǎotīng.
examples.english: Her voice is lovely.

市.meaning: city; municipality (bound/administrative): 上海市 Shanghai municipality, 市中心 downtown (standalone 'city' is 城市)

examples.hanzi: 上海市的人口很多。
examples.pinyin: Shànghǎi shì de rénkǒu hěn duō.
examples.english: Shanghai municipality has a large population.

市.meaning: market (bound form 超市 supermarket, 菜市 food market)

examples.hanzi: 我家附近有个小菜市。
examples.pinyin: wǒ jiā fùjìn yǒu gè xiǎo càishì.
examples.english: There's a small food market near my home.

试.meaning: to try; to test; to try on: 试一下 have a try, 试衣服 try on clothes (bound in 考试 exam)

examples.hanzi: 这件衣服合不合适，你试一下。
examples.pinyin: zhè jiàn yīfu hé bu héshì, nǐ shì yīxià.
examples.english: Try this on and see if it fits.

室.meaning: room (bound form): 教室 classroom, 办公室 office, 卧室 bedroom

examples.hanzi: 同学们都在教室里自习。
examples.pinyin: tóngxuémen dōu zài jiàoshì lǐ zìxí.
examples.english: The students are all studying in the classroom.

世界.meaning: world: 世界各地 all over the world, 世界上 in the world

examples.hanzi: 他想环游世界。
examples.pinyin: tā xiǎng huányóu shìjiè.
examples.english: He wants to travel around the world.

受.meaning: to receive; to suffer; to endure (mostly bound): 受欢迎 be popular, 受到批评 be criticized, 受不了 can't stand it

examples.hanzi: 这种节目很受年轻人欢迎。
examples.pinyin: zhè zhǒng jiémù hěn shòu niánqīngrén huānyíng.
examples.english: This kind of program is popular with young people.

瘦.connotation: of people generally neutral/often positive in modern usage; can still sound blunt
瘦.meaning: thin; slim (of people and animals): 她很瘦 she is thin, 瘦肉 lean meat

examples.hanzi: 他病了一场，瘦了很多。
examples.pinyin: tā bìng le yī chǎng, shòu le hěn duō.
examples.english: He was ill and lost a lot of weight.

收.meaning: to receive; to collect; to gather: 收到来信 receive a letter, 收衣服 bring in the laundry

examples.hanzi: 我收到了你的邮件。
examples.pinyin: wǒ shōu dào le nǐ de yóujiàn.
examples.english: I received your email.

收.meaning: to close/end; to accept (收工 finish work, 收学生 take on students — beyond level)

examples.hanzi: 下班时间一到，商店就收了。
examples.pinyin: xiàbān shíjiān yī dào, shāngdiàn jiù shōu le.
examples.english: When closing time came, the shop shut up.

受到.meaning: to receive (abstract things: 受到欢迎/影响/教育): 受到大家的欢迎 be warmly received

examples.hanzi: 他的建议受到了大家的欢迎。
examples.pinyin: tā de jiànyì shòudào le dàjiā de huānyíng.
examples.english: His suggestion was warmly received.

收到.meaning: to receive (concrete things: letters, packages, messages): 收到邮件 got the email

examples.hanzi: 我刚刚收到家里的包裹。
examples.pinyin: wǒ gānggāng shōudào jiāli de bāoguǒ.
examples.english: I just received a package from home.

树.meaning: tree (measure word 棵): 一棵树 a tree, 树下 under the tree

examples.hanzi: 院子里有一棵大树。
examples.pinyin: yuànzi lǐ yǒu yī kē dà shù.
examples.english: There's a big tree in the yard.

刷.meaning: to brush: 刷牙 brush one's teeth, 刷鞋 scrub shoes

examples.hanzi: 他刷牙的时候喜欢听歌。
examples.pinyin: tā shuā yá de shíhou xǐhuān tīng gē.
examples.english: He listens to music while brushing his teeth.

刷.meaning: to swipe/scroll (phone) (colloquial): 刷手机 scroll on the phone, 刷视频 watch videos

examples.hanzi: 睡觉前他躺在床上刷了一会儿手机。
examples.pinyin: shujiào qián tā tǎng zài chuáng shang shuā le yīhuìr shǒujī.
examples.english: Before sleep he lay in bed scrolling his phone a while.

双.meaning: measure word for pairs: 一双鞋 a pair of shoes, 一双筷子 a pair of chopsticks

examples.hanzi: 我买了一双新鞋。
examples.pinyin: wǒ mǎi le yī shuāng xīn xié.
examples.english: I bought a new pair of shoes.

双.meaning: pair; double; both (双手 both hands, 双方 both sides — bound/compounds)

examples.hanzi: 他双手拿着两大袋东西。
examples.pinyin: tā shuāng shǒu ná zhe liǎng dà dài dōngxi.
examples.english: He carried two big bags in both hands.

水平.meaning: level; standard (of skill): 汉语水平 Chinese level, 提高水平 raise one's level

examples.hanzi: 他的汉语水平提高得很快。
examples.pinyin: tā de Hànyǔ shuǐpíng tígāo de hěn kuài.
examples.english: His Chinese level is improving quickly.

叔叔.meaning: uncle (father's younger brother); a child's polite address for a man: 叔叔好 hello uncle

examples.hanzi: 叔叔带我去公园玩儿。
examples.pinyin: shūshu dài wǒ qù gōngyuán wánr.
examples.english: Uncle took me to the park to play.

数学.meaning: mathematics; math: 数学课 math class, 数学很难 math is hard

examples.hanzi: 我们班数学最好的是小明。
examples.pinyin: wǒmen bān shùxué zuì hǎo de shì Xiǎomíng.
examples.english: The best at math in our class is Xiaoming.

四季.meaning: the four seasons: 四季分明 four distinct seasons

examples.hanzi: 昆明四季如春。
examples.pinyin: Kūnmíng sì jì rú chūn.
examples.english: Kunming is spring-like all four seasons.

司机.meaning: driver: 出租车司机 taxi driver, 司机师傅 the driver (polite)

examples.hanzi: 出租车司机很热情。
examples.pinyin: chūzūchē sījī hěn rèqíng.
examples.english: The taxi driver was very warm.

太阳.meaning: the sun: 太阳出来了 the sun has come out, 晒太阳 bask in the sun

examples.hanzi: 太阳出来了，暖和多了。
examples.pinyin: tàiyáng chū lái le, nuǎnhuo duō le.
examples.english: The sun's out; it's much warmer.

糖.meaning: sugar; candy; sweets: 一块糖 a piece of candy, 加糖 add sugar

examples.hanzi: 小孩子吃太多糖对牙不好。
examples.pinyin: xiǎo háizi chī tài duō táng duì yá bù hǎo.
examples.english: Too much candy is bad for children's teeth.

特别.meaning: especially; particularly: 特别好吃 especially delicious, 特别忙 especially busy

examples.hanzi: 这家餐馆的鱼特别好吃。
examples.pinyin: zhè jiā cānguǎn de yú tèbié hǎochī.
examples.english: This restaurant's fish is especially delicious.

特别.meaning: special; particular: 特别的地方 somewhere special, 特别的礼物 a special gift

examples.hanzi: 今天的晚会很特别，大家都不会忘。
examples.pinyin: jīntiān de wǎnhuì hěn tèbié, dàjiā dōu bù huì wàng.
examples.english: Today's party was special; no one will forget it.

甜.meaning: sweet: 蛋糕很甜 the cake is sweet, 西瓜真甜 the watermelon is really sweet

examples.hanzi: 这个西瓜真甜。
examples.pinyin: zhège xīguā zhēn tián.
examples.english: This watermelon is really sweet.

跳.meaning: to jump; to leap: 跳得很高 jump very high, 跳绳 jump rope

examples.hanzi: 小孩子们又唱又跳。
examples.pinyin: xiǎo háizimen yòu chàng yòu tiào.
examples.english: The little children sang and danced.

跳.meaning: to dance (colloquial for 跳舞): 跳舞 dance, 跳个舞 do a dance

examples.hanzi: 他跳舞跳得很好。
examples.pinyin: tā tiào wǔ tiào de hěn hǎo.
examples.english: He dances very well.

提高.meaning: to raise; to increase; to improve: 提高水平 raise one's level, 价格提高了 prices went up

examples.hanzi: 多说多练才能提高口语水平。
examples.pinyin: duō shuō duō liàn cái néng tígāo kǒuyǔ shuǐpíng.
examples.english: Only lots of speaking and practice can raise your speaking level.

挺.meaning: quite; pretty (before adjectives, colloquial, needs 跟 complement): 挺好 quite good, 挺有意思 pretty interesting

examples.hanzi: 今天挺冷的，多穿点儿。
examples.pinyin: jīntiān tǐng lěng de, duō chuān diǎnr.
examples.english: It's quite cold today; wear more.

挺.meaning: to stand erect; to hold out (挺直 straighten, 挺住 hang on — mostly beyond level)

examples.hanzi: 再坚持一下，困难的时候要挺住。
examples.pinyin: zài jiānchí yīxià, kùnnán de shíhou yào tǐng zhù.
examples.english: Hold on a bit more; you must hang on in hard times.

听说.meaning: to hear (it said); I hear that…: 听说他要去上海 I hear he's going to Shanghai, 听说很贵 they say it's expensive

examples.hanzi: 听说那家饭馆的面很好吃。
examples.pinyin: tīngshuō nà jiā fànguǎn de miàn hěn hǎochī.
examples.english: I hear the noodles at that restaurant are great.

体育.meaning: physical education; sports: 体育课 PE class, 体育运动 sports

examples.hanzi: 我们每周有两节体育课。
examples.pinyin: wǒmen měi zhōu yǒu liǎng jié tǐyù kè.
examples.english: We have two PE classes a week.

体育馆.meaning: gymnasium; indoor stadium: 去体育馆打球 go to the gym to play ball

examples.hanzi: 篮球比赛在体育馆举行。
examples.pinyin: lánqiú bǐsài zài tǐyùguǎn jǔxíng.
examples.english: The basketball match is held in the gymnasium.

同事.meaning: colleague; coworker: 公司的同事 colleagues at the company

examples.hanzi: 他和同事们相处得很好。
examples.pinyin: tā hé tóngshìmen xiāngchǔ de hěn hǎo.
examples.english: He gets along well with his colleagues.

同意.meaning: to agree; to approve: 我同意你的看法 I agree with your view, 大家同意 everyone agrees

examples.hanzi: 我同意你的看法。
examples.pinyin: wǒ tóngyì nǐ de kànfǎ.
examples.english: I agree with your view.

头发.meaning: hair (on the head): 理发/剪头发 cut hair, 长头发 long hair

examples.hanzi: 她剪短了头发。
examples.pinyin: tā jiǎn duǎn le tóufa.
examples.english: She cut her hair short.

腿.meaning: leg (measure word 条): 一条腿 a leg, 腿疼 sore leg

examples.hanzi: 坐了一天，腿都麻了。
examples.pinyin: zuò le yī tiān, tuǐ dōu má le.
examples.english: After sitting all day, my legs went numb.

突然.meaning: sudden; suddenly: 突然下雨了 it suddenly rained, 突然的事件 a sudden event

examples.hanzi: 突然停电了，屋里一片黑。
examples.pinyin: tūrán tíngdiàn le, wū lǐ yī piàn hēi.
examples.english: The power suddenly went out; the room went dark.

图书馆.meaning: library: 在图书馆看书 read in the library, 去图书馆 go to the library

examples.hanzi: 他每天放学后都去图书馆学习。
examples.pinyin: tā měitiān fàngxué hòu dōu qù túshūguǎn xuéxí.
examples.english: He studies at the library after school every day.

外地.meaning: places away from one's home area; other parts of the country: 外地人 out-of-towner, 去外地工作 go work in another city

examples.hanzi: 他在外地工作，一年只回家两次。
examples.pinyin: tā zài wàidì gōngzuò, yī nián zhǐ huí jiā liǎng cì.
examples.english: He works away from home and returns only twice a year.

外卖.meaning: takeout; food delivery: 点外卖 order takeout, 外卖员 delivery rider

examples.hanzi: 下雨天点外卖最方便。
examples.pinyin: xiàyǔ tiān diǎn wàimài zuì fāngbiàn.
examples.english: Ordering takeout is most convenient on rainy days.

外语.meaning: foreign language: 学外语 study a foreign language, 外语水平 foreign-language level

examples.hanzi: 她外语说得像本地人一样。
examples.pinyin: tā wàiyǔ shuō de xiàng běndìrén yīyàng.
examples.english: She speaks the foreign language like a native.

碗.meaning: bowl; measure word for bowlfuls: 一碗饭 a bowl of rice, 大碗/小碗 large/small bowl

examples.hanzi: 他吃了两碗米饭。
examples.pinyin: tā chī le liǎng wǎn mǐfàn.
examples.english: He ate two bowls of rice.

完成.meaning: to complete; to finish (a task, assignment): 完成作业 finish the homework, 按时完成 complete on time

examples.hanzi: 他终于完成了这篇论文。
examples.pinyin: tā zhōngyú wánchéng le zhè piān lùnwén.
examples.english: He finally finished this paper.

晚点.meaning: to be delayed; late (of planes/trains): 飞机晚点了 the flight is delayed

examples.hanzi: 火车晚点了半个小时。
examples.pinyin: huǒchē wǎndiǎn le bàn gè xiǎoshí.
examples.english: The train was half an hour late.

晚点.meaning: a bit later (晚 + 点): 晚点儿再来 come a little later

examples.hanzi: 我们晚点儿再走，先把饭吃完。
examples.pinyin: wǒmen wǎndiǎnr zài zǒu, xiān bǎ fàn chī wán.
examples.english: Let's leave a bit later — finish eating first.

忘记.meaning: to forget: 忘记带钥匙 forgot to bring keys, 我忘了 I forgot (忘 alone same meaning) — separable: 忘得一干二净

examples.hanzi: 我忘记带钱包了。
examples.pinyin: wǒ wàngjì dài qiánbāo le.
examples.english: I forgot to bring my wallet.

网球.meaning: tennis: 打网球 play tennis, 网球场 tennis court

examples.hanzi: 他每个周末都打网球。
examples.pinyin: tā měi gè zhōumò dōu dǎ wǎngqiú.
examples.english: He plays tennis every weekend.

网站.meaning: website: 上这个网站 visit this website, 购物网站 shopping website

examples.hanzi: 这个网站可以免费学外语。
examples.pinyin: zhège wǎngzhàn kěyǐ miǎnfèi xué wàiyǔ.
examples.english: This website teaches foreign languages for free.

晚会.meaning: evening party; gala: 新年晚会 New Year's gala, 举办晚会 hold an evening party

examples.hanzi: 学校周末有一场新年晚会。
examples.pinyin: xuéxiào zhōumò yǒu yī chǎng xīnnián wǎnhuì.
examples.english: The school has a New Year's party this weekend.

为.meaning: for; for the sake of; on behalf of: 为人民服务 serve the people, 为他高兴 be happy for him

examples.hanzi: 他为她做了很多事。
examples.pinyin: tā wèi tā zuò le hěn duō shì.
examples.english: He did a lot for her.

为.meaning: to be; to become (literary bound form in 成为, 认为, 以为)

examples.pinyin: chéngwéi yī míng yīshēng shì tā de mèngxiǎng.
examples.english: Becoming a doctor is his dream.

为了.meaning: in order to; for the sake of: 为了学好汉语，他去了中国 in order to learn Chinese well, he went to China

examples.hanzi: 为了学好汉语，他每天听录音。
examples.pinyin: wèile xué hǎo Hànyǔ, tā měitiān tīng lùyīn.
examples.english: To learn Chinese well, he listens to recordings every day.

卫生间.meaning: bathroom; restroom: 去卫生间 go to the restroom

examples.hanzi: 请问卫生间在哪儿？
examples.pinyin: qǐngwèn wèishēngjiān zài nǎr?
examples.english: Where is the restroom, please?

文化.meaning: culture: 中国文化 Chinese culture, 文化水平 level of education

examples.hanzi: 两国文化有很多不同。
examples.pinyin: liǎng guó wénhuà yǒu hěn duō bùtóng.
examples.english: The two countries' cultures differ in many ways.

屋子.meaning: room (colloquial): 屋子里很暖和 it's nice and warm in the room

examples.hanzi: 屋子里又干净又整齐。
examples.pinyin: wūzi lǐ yòu gānjìng yòu zhěngqí.
examples.english: The room is clean and tidy.

西.meaning: west: 往西走 go west, 西边 the west side

examples.hanzi: 太阳往西边落下去了。
examples.pinyin: tàiyáng wǎng xībiān luò xiàqù le.
examples.english: The sun is setting in the west.

喜爱.meaning: to love; to be fond of (written, warmer than 喜欢): 深受大家喜爱 loved by everyone

examples.hanzi: 这部电影深受观众喜爱。
examples.pinyin: zhè bù diànyǐng shēn shòu guānzhòng xǐ'ài.
examples.english: This film is deeply loved by audiences.

先.meaning: first; before (doing something else): 你先走 you go first, 先做作业，再玩 do homework first, then play

examples.hanzi: 你先吃，我一会儿就来。
examples.pinyin: nǐ xiān chī, wǒ yīhuìr jiù lái.
examples.english: You start eating; I'll be along shortly.

向.meaning: toward; to (direction or target): 向他学习 learn from him, 向老师请假 ask the teacher for leave, 一直向北走 keep walking north

examples.hanzi: 遇到不懂的问题要向老师请教。
examples.pinyin: yùdào bù dǒng de wèntí yào xiàng lǎoshī qǐngjiào.

像.meaning: to be like; to resemble: 她长得像她妈妈 she looks like her mother, 像我这样的学生 students like me

examples.hanzi: 这对姐妹长得非常像。
examples.pinyin: zhè duì jiěmèi zhǎng de fēicháng xiàng.

像.meaning: for example; such as (introducing examples): 像北京、上海这样的大城市 big cities like Beijing and Shanghai

examples.hanzi: 像他这样的好学生不多。

相机.meaning: camera: 用相机拍照 take photos with a camera

examples.pinyin: tā dài zhe xiàngjī qù lǚxíng le.
examples.english: He went traveling with his camera.

香蕉.meaning: banana: 一根香蕉 a banana

examples.hanzi: 猴子最爱吃香蕉。
examples.pinyin: hóuzi zuì ài chī xiāngjiāo.
examples.english: Monkeys love bananas most.

相信.meaning: to believe; to trust: 我相信你 I believe you, 相信自己 believe in yourself

examples.hanzi: 我相信你一定能行。
examples.pinyin: wǒ xiāngxìn nǐ yīdìng néng xíng.
examples.english: I believe you can definitely do it.

箱子.meaning: box; case; suitcase: 一个箱子 a box, 把衣服放进箱子里 put the clothes in the suitcase

小区.meaning: residential compound: 我们小区 our compound, 住在小区里 live in the compound

examples.pinyin: wǒmen xiǎoqū lǐ yǒu zìjǐ de huāyuán.

小心.meaning: careful; cautious: 开车小心 drive carefully, 小心点儿 be careful

小心.meaning: to beware of; to mind: 小心玻璃 careful, glass, 小心别摔跤 mind you don't fall

校园.meaning: campus; school grounds: 校园里有很多树 the campus has many trees, 校园生活 campus life

校长.meaning: principal; headmaster: 王校长 Principal Wang

examples.pinyin: xiàozhǎng zài kāixué diǎnlǐ shang jiǎng le huà.

西方.meaning: the west (direction, formal; everyday word is 西边)

西瓜.meaning: watermelon: 一块西瓜 a slice of watermelon, 夏天吃西瓜 eat watermelon in summer

examples.english: Chinese is a very difficult language.

雨衣.meaning: raincoat: 下雨了，穿雨衣 it's raining, wear a raincoat

examples.hanzi: 雨天骑车要穿雨衣。
examples.pinyin: yǔtiān qí chē yào chuān yǔyī.
examples.english: Wear a raincoat when biking in the rain.

脏.meaning: dirty: 手很脏 hands are dirty, 又脏又乱 dirty and messy

examples.hanzi: 玩了一天，手脏得不能看。
examples.pinyin: wán le yī tiān, shǒu zāng de bù néng kàn.
examples.english: After playing all day, his hands were unbelievably dirty.

near_synonyms.difference: 咱们 includes the listener (咱们走吧 you and I go); 我们 may exclude them (我们走了，你留下 we're leaving, you stay)

咱们.meaning: we (inclusive — includes the listener): 咱们走吧 let's go (我们 excludes the listener or is neutral)

examples.hanzi: 咱们都是老朋友，别客气。
examples.pinyin: zánmen dōu shì lǎo péngyou, bié kèqi.
examples.english: We're all old friends; don't be polite.

怎么办.meaning: what to do; what should (we) do: 忘了带钥匙，怎么办 I forgot the keys — what now?

examples.hanzi: 明天突然要考试，怎么办？
examples.pinyin: míngtiān tūrán yào kǎoshì, zěnmebàn?
examples.english: There's a surprise exam tomorrow — what do I do?

怎样.meaning: how; in what way: 怎样才能学好汉语 how can one learn Chinese well? (怎么样 asks 'how is it'; 怎样 leans 'by what means')

examples.hanzi: 怎样才能记住这么多生词？
examples.pinyin: zěnyàng cái néng jì zhù zhème duō shēngcí?
examples.english: How can I memorize so many new words?

站2.meaning: to stand: 站起来 stand up, 站了半天 stood for ages

examples.hanzi: 请大家站起来回答问题。
examples.pinyin: qǐng dàjiā zhàn qǐlái huídá wèntí.
examples.english: Please stand up to answer the question.

站2.meaning: station; stop: 火车站 train station, 下一站 next stop

examples.hanzi: 我在下一站下车。
examples.pinyin: wǒ zài xià yī zhàn xià chē.
examples.english: I'm getting off at the next stop.

长.meaning: long (length or duration): 头发很长 long hair, 会议很长 the meeting is long

examples.hanzi: 从家到学校的路很长。
examples.pinyin: cóng jiā dào xuéxiào de lù hěn cháng.
examples.english: The road from home to school is long.

长.meaning: to grow; to grow up: 长大了 grown up, 长得像爸爸 looks like his dad

examples.hanzi: 几年不见，孩子都长这么高了。
examples.pinyin: jǐ nián bù jiàn, háizi dōu zhǎng zhème gāo le.
examples.english: After several years, the child has grown this tall.

长.meaning: head; chief (bound form: 校长 principal, 市长 mayor) — beyond HSK3

examples.hanzi: 王校长明年退休。
examples.pinyin: Wáng xiàozhǎng míngnián tuìxiū.
examples.english: Principal Wang retires next year.

张.meaning: measure word for flat objects (paper, tickets, tables, beds, faces): 一张纸 a sheet of paper, 一张桌子 a table

examples.hanzi: 他递给我一张名片。
examples.pinyin: tā dì gěi wǒ yī zhāng míngpiàn.
examples.english: He handed me a business card.

张.meaning: to open; to spread (张嘴 open one's mouth — beyond level)

examples.hanzi: 他张了张嘴，什么也没说。
examples.pinyin: tā zhāng le zhāng zuǐ, shénme yě méi shuō.
examples.english: He opened his mouth but said nothing.

照.meaning: to take a photo (in 拍照/照相): 帮我照张像 take a photo for me

examples.hanzi: 我们在门口照张相吧。
examples.pinyin: wǒmen zài ménkǒu zhào zhāng xiàng ba.
examples.english: Let's take a photo at the entrance.

照.meaning: according to; in the manner of: 照他说的做 do as he says, 照这个办法办 do it this way

examples.hanzi: 照爸爸说的做，不会有错。
examples.pinyin: zhào bàba shuō de zuò, bù huì yǒu cuò.
examples.english: Do as Dad says and you won't go wrong.

照.meaning: to shine; to reflect (阳光照进来 the sunlight shines in — beyond level)

examples.hanzi: 阳光照进屋里，暖和极了。
examples.pinyin: yángguāng zhào jìn wū lǐ, nuǎnhuo jí le.
examples.english: Sunlight shone into the room; it was wonderfully warm.

照顾.meaning: to look after; to care for: 照顾孩子 look after children, 在家照顾父母 care for parents at home

examples.hanzi: 妈妈生病了，我在家照顾她。
examples.pinyin: māma shēngbìng le, wǒ zài jiā zhàogù tā.
examples.english: Mom is sick; I'm caring for her at home.

着急.meaning: anxious; worried; in a rush: 别着急 don't worry, 着急用 need to use it right away

examples.hanzi: 别着急，慢慢说。
examples.pinyin: bié zháojí, mànmàn shuō.
examples.english: Don't be anxious; speak slowly.

照片.meaning: photo; picture (measure word 张): 一张照片 a photo, 拍照片 take photos

examples.hanzi: 这张照片是十年前照的。
examples.pinyin: zhè zhāng zhàopiàn shì shí nián qián zhào de.
examples.english: This photo was taken ten years ago.

照相.meaning: to take a photo: 去公园照相 go take photos in the park — separable: 照张相

examples.hanzi: 游客们在长城上照相。
examples.pinyin: yóukèmen zài Chángchéng shang zhàoxiàng.
examples.english: Tourists take photos on the Great Wall.

只.meaning: only; just: 只有一个 only one, 他只喝咖啡 he only drinks coffee

examples.hanzi: 他只学过一年汉语。
examples.pinyin: tā zhǐ xué guo yī nián Hànyǔ.
examples.english: He's only studied Chinese one year.

只.meaning: measure word for animals and one of a pair: 一只猫 a cat, 一只鞋 one shoe

examples.hanzi: 家里养了一只猫和一只狗。
examples.pinyin: jiā lǐ yǎng le yī zhī māo hé yī zhī gǒu.
examples.english: The family keeps a cat and a dog.

只.meaning: one of a pair (bound use: 只脚 one foot — standalone rare)

examples.hanzi: 他只说了一句就走了。
examples.pinyin: tā zhǐ shuō le yī jù jiù zǒu le.
examples.english: He said just one sentence and left.

纸.meaning: paper (measure word 张): 一张纸 a sheet of paper, 一张白纸 a sheet of white paper

examples.hanzi: 请给我一张纸。
examples.pinyin: qǐng gěi wǒ yī zhāng zhǐ.
examples.english: Please give me a sheet of paper.

只能.meaning: can only; have no choice but to: 只能等 can only wait, 只能这样了 it can only be this way

examples.hanzi: 票卖完了，我们只能明天再来。
examples.pinyin: piào mài wán le, wǒmen zhǐnéng míngtiān zài lái.
examples.english: Tickets are sold out; we can only come back tomorrow.

直到.meaning: until; up to (a time or state): 直到半夜 until midnight, 直到现在才明白 only now understand

examples.hanzi: 从早上直到半夜，他一直在图书馆学习。
examples.pinyin: cóng zǎoshang zhídào bànyè, tā yīzhí zài túshūguǎn xuéxí.
examples.english: From morning until midnight he studied at the library.

只是.meaning: merely; it's just that: 只是想帮忙 just wanted to help, 他只是累了 he was just tired

examples.hanzi: 我只是开个玩笑，别生气。
examples.pinyin: wǒ zhǐshì kāi gè wánxiào, bié shēngqì.
examples.english: I was only joking; don't be angry.

只是.meaning: but; only (mild contrast after a concession): 想去，只是没时间 I'd like to go, only I have no time

examples.hanzi: 我很想帮你，只是没有时间。
examples.pinyin: wǒ hěn xiǎng bāng nǐ, zhǐshì méiyǒu shíjiān.
examples.english: I'd really like to help, only I have no time.

只要.meaning: as long as; provided that (usually with 就): 只要努力，就能学好 as long as you work hard, you can learn it well

examples.hanzi: 只要努力，就一定能学好。
examples.pinyin: zhǐyào nǔlì, jiù yīdìng néng xué hǎo.
examples.english: As long as you work hard, you can surely learn it well.

只有.meaning: only; alone (a sole instance): 只有他来了 only he came, 只有一次 only once

examples.hanzi: 家里只有他一个人会说英语。
examples.pinyin: jiā lǐ zhǐyǒu tā yī gè rén huì shuō Yīngyǔ.
examples.english: He's the only one at home who speaks English.

只有.meaning: only if; only when (只有…才…): 只有努力才能成功 only by working hard can one succeed

examples.hanzi: 只有多练习，才能说得更流利。
examples.pinyin: zhǐyǒu duō liànxí, cái néng shuō de gèng liúlì.
examples.english: Only with lots of practice can you speak more fluently.

种.meaning: measure word for kinds and types: 一种水果 a kind of fruit, 这种方法 this method

examples.hanzi: 商店里有好几种面包。
examples.pinyin: shāngdiàn lǐ yǒu hǎo jǐ zhǒng miànbāo.
examples.english: The shop has several kinds of bread.

种.meaning: to plant; to grow (crops or plants): 种花 grow flowers, 种树 plant trees

examples.hanzi: 爷爷在后院种菜。
examples.pinyin: yéye zài hòuyuàn zhòng cài.
examples.english: Grandpa grows vegetables in the back yard.

中.meaning: middle; center; among; in: 家中 at home, 心中 in one's heart (bound form; 中 in 中国 China, 中文 Chinese)

examples.hanzi: 他心中一直有个梦想。
examples.pinyin: tā xīnzhōng yīzhí yǒu gè mèngxiǎng.
examples.english: He's always had a dream in his heart.

中.meaning: to hit the mark; to be hit by (中奖 win a lottery, 看中 take a fancy to — beyond level)

examples.hanzi: 他买彩票中了奖。
examples.pinyin: tā mǎi cǎipiào zhòng le jiǎng.
examples.english: He won a prize in the lottery.

中间.meaning: middle; center; between: 桌子中间 the middle of the table, 坐在中间 sit in the middle, 两者之间 between the two

examples.hanzi: 教室中间有一张长桌子。
examples.pinyin: jiàoshì zhōngjiān yǒu yī zhāng cháng zhuōzi.
examples.english: There's a long table in the middle of the classroom.

重要.meaning: important; major: 很重要 very important, 重要的问题 an important question

examples.hanzi: 健康比什么都重要。
examples.pinyin: jiànkāng bǐ shénme dōu zhòngyào.
examples.english: Health matters more than anything.

终于.meaning: finally; at last (after long expectation): 终于到了 finally arrived, 终于考完了 the exams are finally over

examples.hanzi: 等了一个小时，车终于来了。
examples.pinyin: děng le yī gè xiǎoshí, chē zhōngyú lái le.
examples.english: After an hour's wait, the bus finally came.

周末.meaning: weekend: 周末愉快 have a nice weekend, 这个周末 this weekend

examples.hanzi: 周末你有什么安排？
examples.pinyin: zhōumò nǐ yǒu shénme ānpái?
examples.english: What are your plans for the weekend?

主要.meaning: main; principal; primarily: 主要原因 the main reason, 主要是他 mainly it's him

examples.hanzi: 他迟到的主要原因是堵车。
examples.pinyin: tā chídào de zhǔyào yuányīn shì dǔchē.
examples.english: The main reason he was late was traffic.

注意.meaning: to pay attention to; attention: 注意安全 mind your safety, 没注意到 didn't notice

examples.hanzi: 上课要注意听讲。
examples.pinyin: shàngkè yào zhùyì tīng jiǎng.
examples.english: Pay attention to the lecture in class.

住院.meaning: to be hospitalized: 他住院了 he's in the hospital — separable: 住了三天院

examples.hanzi: 爷爷住院一个星期了。
examples.pinyin: yéye zhù yuàn yī gè xīngqī le.
examples.english: Grandpa has been in the hospital a week.

子.meaning: child; son; seed (bound suffix only: 儿子 son, 孩子 child, 种子 seed)

examples.hanzi: 父子俩长得一模一样。
examples.pinyin: fùzǐ liǎ zhǎng de yīmú-yīyàng.
examples.english: Father and son look exactly alike.

字典.meaning: character dictionary (a 字典 lists characters; a 词典 lists words): 查字典 look it up in the dictionary

examples.hanzi: 遇到不会的字就查字典。
examples.pinyin: yùdào bù huì de zì jiù chá zìdiǎn.
examples.english: Look up unfamiliar characters in the dictionary.

自行车.meaning: bicycle (measure word 辆): 骑自行车去 go by bike

examples.hanzi: 他骑自行车上班。
examples.pinyin: tā qí zìxíngchē shàngbān.
examples.english: He bikes to work.

总.meaning: anyway; after all (colloquial sentence adverb, 总得/总会/总不能): 总得有个办法 there must be some way — mostly bound (总共, 总是)

examples.hanzi: 总得想个办法啊。
examples.pinyin: zǒng děi xiǎng gè bànfǎ a.
examples.english: We've got to think of some way.

总是.meaning: always: 他总是迟到 he's always late, 总是很忙 always busy

examples.hanzi: 他总是第一个到教室。
examples.pinyin: tā zǒngshì dì yī gè dào jiàoshì.
examples.english: He's always the first to arrive in class.

嘴.meaning: mouth: 张开嘴 open your mouth, 嘴里含着糖 has candy in his mouth

examples.hanzi: 他嘴上不说，心里都明白。
examples.pinyin: tā zuǐ shang bù shuō, xīnlǐ dōu míngbai.
examples.english: He doesn't say it, but he understands it all.

最好.meaning: had better; it would be best: 你最好早点儿来 you'd better come early

examples.hanzi: 你最好提前买票。
examples.pinyin: nǐ zuìhǎo tíqián mǎi piào.
examples.english: You'd better buy tickets in advance.

最好.meaning: best; the finest: 最好的朋友 one's best friend

examples.hanzi: 这是我吃过的最好的面条。
examples.pinyin: zhè shì wǒ chī guo de zuì hǎo de miàntiáo.
examples.english: This is the best noodles I've ever had.

最后.meaning: last; final; finally: 最后一课 the last lesson, 谁最后走 who leaves last?

examples.hanzi: 最后一个问题最难。
examples.pinyin: zuìhòu yī gè wèntí zuì nán.
examples.english: The last question is the hardest.

最近.meaning: recently; lately: 最近很忙 very busy lately, 最近怎么样 how have you been?

examples.hanzi: 最近他忙得连饭都顾不上吃。
examples.pinyin: zuìjìn tā máng de lián fàn dōu gù bu shang chī.
examples.english: Lately he's too busy even to eat properly.

做客.meaning: to be a guest at someone's home: 去朋友家做客 be a guest at a friend's home

examples.hanzi: 周末我们去老师家做客。
examples.pinyin: zhōumò wǒmen qù lǎoshī jiā zuò kè.
examples.english: We visited the teacher's home on the weekend.

作业.meaning: homework; assignment: 做作业 do homework, 交作业 hand in homework

examples.hanzi: 写完作业才能看电视。
examples.pinyin: xiě wán zuòyè cái néng kàn diànshì.
examples.english: Only after finishing homework can you watch TV.
